name: Mei Li
bio:
Mei Li's journey into motorsport finance was unconventional. After graduating with a degree in accounting from Tsinghua University, she initially worked for a large tech firm. However, a lifelong passion for racing, fueled by watching Formula 1 races with her father, led her to seek a career change. She started in a junior accounting role at a smaller racing team, quickly proving her aptitude for the specialized financial demands of motorsport. 

Now at Prema Racing, Mei is known for her meticulous approach and sharp eye for detail. She thrives on the fast-paced environment and the pressure of ensuring the team's financial stability. Her pragmatic nature allows her to make difficult decisions objectively, always prioritizing the team's long-term financial health. She is particularly skilled at navigating complex regulatory requirements and optimizing budget allocation for maximum performance gain, a skill she honed through years of experience.

What sets Mei apart is her ability to blend her analytical skills with a deep understanding of the motorsport industry. She doesn't just crunch numbers; she understands how every financial decision impacts the team's ability to compete. Her colleagues value her straightforward communication style and unwavering commitment to financial integrity.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, straight hair with subtle highlights
physical.description: Mei is of average height with a serious, focused expression.

quirks: Always has a cup of green tea on her desk.
Uses a traditional abacus alongside her computer for quick calculations, especially during crunch time.
Keeps a detailed spreadsheet of team performance metrics alongside financial data.
